description_en: Subscribes to an API product on a specified HiMarket consumer. The path parameter specifies the consumer ID, and the request body specifies the ID of the API product to subscribe to. The response returns the subscription ID, API product ID and name, API product type, consumer ID and name, and subscription status of the subscription record
description_zh: 在指定的 HiMarket Consumer 上订阅一个 API 产品：路径参数给出消费者 ID，请求体给出要订阅的 API 产品 ID，调用后返回该订阅记录的订阅 ID、API 产品 ID 与名称、API 产品类型、消费者 ID 与名称以及订阅状态
kebab_example: aliyun apig subscribe-product --consumer-id cs-xxxxxxxxxxxx --product-id product-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubscribeProduct

parameters.help_en: The consumer ID. Specifies the HiMarket consumer for which to subscribe to the API product. This operation authenticates requests based on the consumer. After the subscription record is created, it can be canceled by calling UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct or approved by calling ApproveProductSubscription
parameters.help_zh: 消费者 ID，指定要为哪个 HiMarket Consumer 订阅 API 产品。本接口按该消费者维度鉴权，订阅记录建立后可由 UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct 取消、由 ApproveProductSubscription 审批
parameters.name: consumer_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product to subscribe to. This is the primary ID of the API product resource. You can obtain this ID from the productId field in the response of the ListProducts operation
parameters.help_zh: 要订阅的 API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，可由查询API产品列表（ListProducts）返回的列表项 productId 获得
parameters.name: product_id

consumerId.description_en: The ID of the consumer to which the subscription belongs. This is the same identifier as the consumerId path parameter in the request and refers to the same consumer as the consumerName field returned at the same level
consumerId.description_zh: 订阅所属消费者的 ID，与请求的路径参数 consumerId 为同一标识，并与同层返回的 consumerName 指向同一个消费者

consumerName.description_en: The name of the consumer to which the subscription belongs. This refers to the same consumer as the consumerId field returned at the same level
consumerName.description_zh: 订阅所属消费者的名称，与同层返回的 consumerId 指向同一个消费者

productId.description_en: The ID of the subscribed API product. This is the primary ID of the API product resource and is the same identifier as the productId passed in the request body
productId.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，与请求体中传入的 productId 为同一标识

productName.description_en: The name of the subscribed API product. This is the Name property of the API product resource
productName.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品名称，即 API 产品资源 Product 的 Name 属性

productType.description_en: The type of the subscribed API product. The valid values are not declared in this operation definition. The response parameter with the same name in the related ListProductSubscriptions operation includes the following valid values: REST_API, HTTP_API, MCP_SERVER, AGENT_API, and MODEL_API
productType.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品类型。取值集合未在本篇接口定义中声明；同族接口 ListProductSubscriptions 的同名出参挂了 @enums，其枚举为 REST_API、HTTP_API、MCP_SERVER、AGENT_API、MODEL_API

status.description_en: The subscription status. Valid values: PENDING and APPROVED. These valid values are declared in the status request parameter of the related ListProductSubscriptions operation
status.description_zh: 订阅状态。取值：PENDING、APPROVED（该取值集合声明在同族接口 ListProductSubscriptions 入参 status 的枚举上，本篇出参未挂 @enums）

subscriptionId.description_en: The subscription ID. Identifies the API product subscription record corresponding to this subscription. You can use this ID to cancel the subscription by calling UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct or approve the subscription by calling ApproveProductSubscription. Both operations locate the record by using the /himarket/v1/consumers/{consumerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId} path
subscriptionId.description_zh: 订阅 ID，标识本次订阅对应的 API 产品订阅记录。可用于 UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct 取消该订阅、ApproveProductSubscription 审批该订阅，二者均以 /himarket/v1/consumers/{consumerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId} 定位该记录

v1_parameters.help_en: The consumer ID. Specifies the HiMarket consumer for which to subscribe to the API product. This operation authenticates requests based on the consumer. After the subscription record is created, it can be canceled by calling UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct or approved by calling ApproveProductSubscription
v1_parameters.help_zh: 消费者 ID，指定要为哪个 HiMarket Consumer 订阅 API 产品。本接口按该消费者维度鉴权，订阅记录建立后可由 UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct 取消、由 ApproveProductSubscription 审批
v1_parameters.name: consumerId
